attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Reports of Audit Committee and Independent Directors of the Company certifying that the Company has compensated the eligible shareholders of Quality Care India Limited who were eligible for fractional shares of the Company pursuant to the Scheme'.
voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited submitted reports from its Audit Committee and Independent Directors certifying the distribution of net sale proceeds to shareholders entitled to fractional shares following the amalgamation with Quality Care India Limited. The scheme became effective on 1 July 2026. On 13 July 2026, the company allotted 35,35,51,410 equity shares to eligible shareholders. Consolidated fractional shares totaling 65 equity shares were sold on the National Stock Exchange of India on 8 October 2026 at an average price of 676.0669 per share. Gross sale proceeds were 43,944.35. After deducting charges of 65.92, net proceeds of 43,834.43 were available for distribution. The distribution process was undertaken on 3 November 2026. An amount of 1,886.45 pertaining to 8 eligible shareholders could not be remitted and remains held by the company.

attchmntText: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Andhra Jyothi on 7 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a net profit after tax of 7,645.00 lakhs. The basic earnings per share was 6.75. Total income from operations stood at 17,036.11 lakhs. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, net profit after tax was 4,149.00 lakhs with basic earnings per share of 4.97. Total income from operations was 8,306.25 lakhs. The paid-up equity share capital is 11,625.89 lakhs. The net worth is 1,78,213.72 lakhs. The debt equity ratio is 0.78.
